record_actor_pose_keyframe.description: Create or update a frame on the shared project frame grid. Pose and additive offsetX/Y/Z in meters. Offsets use the sampled Move/Hold heading before rotationYOffset: +X right, +Y up, +Z forward, independent of actor scale. Hold owns stand/sit and leg geometry; Move owns the base path. Avoid overlapping visible coplanar surfaces (z-fighting): join adjacent floors, platforms and walls edge to edge. Give decorative overlays real thickness or clear separation. Equal-height surfaces may meet without overlapping. Inspect the viewport after authoring.
